# Mastery Goals

## Graph
```{r}
scaleScores %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MasteryGoal_score_byAvg)
  ) %>%
  scatterPlot_general(
    xVar = Time
    , yVar = MasteryGoal_score_byAvg
    , xLab = "time"
    , yLab = "Mastery Goals"
    , fillVar = sectionID
    , fillLimits = c("RU02", "RU03")
    , fillValues = c("lightblue", "magenta")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ sectionID
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      group = ID
    )
    , position = position_dodge2(width = 0.5)
    , shape = 21
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = ID)
    , position = position_dodge2(width = 0.5)
    , alpha = 0.2
  )
```
## Stats

Endorsement of mastery goals in science decreases at the end of the course
```{r}
mixed(
  MasteryGoal_score_byAvg ~ sectionID * Time + (1|ID)
  , data = scaleScores
  , method = "KR"
)
```

```{r}
scaleScores %>%
```

## Post
```{r}
scaleScores %>%

         PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg, Interest_score_byAvg, BelongingPre_score_byAvg, Time) %>%
```

The relationship between science interest and mastery goals and science self-efficacy and mastery goals seems to get stronger at the end of the course

```{r}
scaleScores_timeVal <- scaleScores %>%
```

# Principle Component Analysis
Make wide form
```{r}
forPCA_wide<-scaleScores %>%
  select(
    -starts_with("BelongingPost_")
      , -starts_with("ClassEngagement_")
      , -SC0
      , -(type:ClassEngagement_5)
    )%>%
  select(
    ID
    , sectionID
    , Time
    , ends_with("_byAvg")
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(ID, sectionID)
    , names_from = Time
    , values_from = where(is.numeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    if_all(where(is.numeric), ~!is.na(.))
  )

forPCA_change <- forPCA_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Fixed = Fixed_score_byAvg_post - Fixed_score_byAvg_pre
    , Growth = Growth_score_byAvg_post - Growth_score_byAvg_pre
    , SciEfficacy = SciEfficacy_score_byAvg_post - SciEfficacy_score_byAvg_pre
    , MasteryGoal = MasteryGoal_score_byAvg_post - MasteryGoal_score_byAvg_pre
    , PerformanceGoal = PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg_post - PerformanceGoal_score_byAvg_pre
    , Interest = Interest_score_byAvg_post - Interest_score_byAvg_pre
    , Belonging = BelongingPre_score_byAvg_post - BelongingPre_score_byAvg_pre
  ) %>%
  select(
    -(ends_with("_byAvg_pre"))
    , -(ends_with("_byAvg_post"))
  )

forPCA_change
```

## Create PCA results

```{r}
pca_res_change <- prcomp(forPCA_change %>% select(-ID, -sectionID), center=TRUE, scale.=TRUE)
```

## Decide on clusters

How many PCs explain 80-90% variance?
Out to PC4 gets to just about 80% variance
```{r}
summary(pca_res_change)

n_pcs <- 4
```

Decide number of clusters

Elbow method
```{r}
wss <- numeric()

for (k in 1:10) {
  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(pca_res_change$x[, 1:n_pcs], centers = k, nstart = 25)
  wss[k] <- km$tot.withinss
}

plot(1:10, wss, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
     ylab = "Total within-cluster sum of squares")

```

Silhouette Method
```{r}
library(cluster)

sil_width <- numeric()

for (k in 2:10) {
  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(pca_res_change$x[, 1:n_pcs], centers = k, nstart = 25)
  ss <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(pca_res_change$x[, 1:2]))
  sil_width[k] <- mean(ss[, 3])
}

plot(1:10, sil_width, type = "b",
     xlab = "Number of clusters (k)",
     ylab = "Average silhouette width")

```

## Make clusters

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
n_clusters = 4
clusters_change <- kmeans(pca_res_change$x[, 1:n_pcs], centers = n_clusters, nstart = 25)$cluster  # choose number of clusters

pca_df_change <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_res_change$x[,1]
  , PC2 = pca_res_change$x[,2]
  , PC3 = pca_res_change$x[,3]
  , ID = forPCA_change$ID
  , sectionID = forPCA_change$sectionID
  , cluster = factor(clusters_change)
) 
```


## Plot clusters

```{r}
ggplot(
  pca_df_change
  , aes(
    x = PC1
    , y = PC2
    , color = cluster
    )) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "PC1",
    y = "PC2"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top" 
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    ~ sectionID
  )
```
## Check loadings
```{r}
# PCA loadings
loadings_change <- pca_res_change$rotation

# Optionally look at the top contributing variables for PC1-3
top_PC1_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,1]), decreasing = TRUE)
top_PC2_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,2]), decreasing = TRUE)
top_PC3_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,3]), decreasing = TRUE)
top_PC4_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,4]), decreasing = TRUE)
top_PC5_change <- sort(abs(loadings_change[,5]), decreasing = TRUE)

print("PC1")
head(top_PC1_change, 7)  # top 7 contributors to PC1
print("PC2")
head(top_PC2_change, 7)  # top 7 contributors to PC2
print("PC3")
head(top_PC3_change, 7)  # top 7 contributors to PC3
print("PC4")
head(top_PC4_change, 7)  # top 7 contributors to PC4
print("PC5")
head(top_PC5_change, 7)  # top 7 contributors to PC5
```

## Do sections differ?

```{r}
table(pca_df_change$cluster, pca_df_change$sectionID)
fisher.test(table(pca_df_change$cluster, pca_df_change$sectionID))
```
```{r}

aggregate(pca_df_change[, c("PC1","PC2", "PC3")],
          by = list(section = pca_df_change$sectionID),
          mean)


t.test(PC1 ~ sectionID, data = pca_df_change)
t.test(PC2 ~ sectionID, data = pca_df_change)

```

## Look at scales by cluster

```{r}
change_clusters <- pca_df_change %>%
  select(
    ID
    , sectionID
    , cluster
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    forPCA_change
    , by = c("ID", "sectionID")
  )

change_clusters
```


```{r}
change_clusters %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Fixed:Belonging)
    , names_to = "resp_scale"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    resp_scale = case_when(
      resp_scale == "MasteryGoal" ~ "Mastery\nGoal"
      , resp_scale == "PerformanceGoal" ~ "Performance\nGoal"
      , TRUE ~ resp_scale
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = cluster
      , y = value
      , color = resp_scale
      , group = resp_scale
    )
  ) +
  geom_beeswarm(
    dodge.width = 0.7
    , cex = 0.5
    # , shape = 21
    , alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  theme_pubr() +
  addMeanHorizontalBar(
    barPosition = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
    , meanColor = NULL
  ) +
  addMeanSE_vertBar(
    barPosition = position_dodge(width = 0.7)
    , barColor = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "change in average score"
  )
```
### MANOVA
```{r}
manova_res <- manova(
  cbind(Fixed, Growth, SciEfficacy, MasteryGoal,
        PerformanceGoal, Interest, Belonging) ~ factor(cluster),
  data = change_clusters
)

summary(manova_res)
summary.aov(manova_res)
```

### emmeans

```{r}

library(emmeans)

vars <- c("Fixed","Growth","SciEfficacy","MasteryGoal",
          "PerformanceGoal","Interest","Belonging")

for (v in vars) {
  cat("\n====================\n")
  cat("Variable:", v, "\n")
  
  model <- aov(as.formula(paste(v, "~ factor(cluster)")),
               data = change_clusters)
  
  em <- emmeans(model, ~ cluster)
  
  print(multcomp::cld(em, Letters = letters))
}

```
